_comment: Right Path Daily Direction / Next Best Action decision. Adapted from IPF (bobpfromm/ipf-stewardship) src/rules/next-best-action.json, the established GoRules ZEN decision layer. ZEN owns ALL priority ordering; the composition passes only independent presence facts. The ordering reflects ONLY established Right Path distinctions and invents none. Established facts: (a) ready-to-call, ready-to-email, and a due promised callback are all ordinary OUTREACH action work and are EQUALLY ELIGIBLE — Right Path has no business rule ranking calls over emails, nor one making a date-only callback universally outrank other outreach, so they share one tier and ZEN emits a single 'outreach' verdict without choosing among them; (b) research-needed is explicitly the EXCEPTION path on the board, so it ranks after ordinary outreach; (c) waiting states (on customers/carriers) come after all actionable work; (d) an empty board is open capacity. A date-only callback is DUE WORK within the outreach tier, surfaced distinctly to the operator by the UI, never a fixed-time interruption and never an automatic top priority.

rules._description: Ordinary outreach action work exists (any of: ready-to-call, ready-to-email, or a due promised callback). These are equally eligible; ZEN emits one outreach verdict and does NOT rank among them. The operator chooses which specific item within the outreach work; a due callback is highlighted by the UI as due, not promoted here.
No ordinary outreach remains. Research-needed is the explicit EXCEPTION path on the board, so it is the next action only once ordinary outreach is exhausted.
No action work, but items are waiting on customers or carriers: nothing to push right now, work is in flight.
